resources.title: Do Things That Don't Scale
resources.author: Paul Graham
resources.note: July 2013. The canonical argument that founders must recruit users manually and delight them at unscalable cost before any growth machine exists.

resources.title: Startup = Growth
resources.author: Paul Graham
resources.note: September 2012. Defines a startup by its growth rate and argues for picking a weekly growth target and steering the whole company by it.

resources.title: Default Alive or Default Dead?
resources.author: Paul Graham
resources.note: October 2015. Defines the default-alive test (constant expenses, current growth: do you reach profitability on the money you have?) and links Trevor Blackwell's calculator. Implemented in lib/openstartup/runway.ts.

resources.title: Startups in 13 Sentences
resources.author: Paul Graham
resources.note: February 2009. The most compressed statement of the YC canon: launch fast, make a few users love you, spend little, understand your users.

resources.title: How to Start a Startup
resources.author: Paul Graham
resources.note: March 2005. The pre-YC founding text: good people, make something customers want, spend as little as possible.

resources.title: Before the Startup
resources.author: Paul Graham
resources.note: October 2014. Startups are so counterintuitive that trusting instincts trained elsewhere fails; expertise in startups is not what matters — users are.

resources.title: The 18 Mistakes That Kill Startups
resources.author: Paul Graham
resources.note: October 2006. Enumerates the recurring killers; concludes they are all proxies for a single mistake — not making something users want.

resources.title: The Equity Equation
resources.author: Paul Graham
resources.note: July 2007. The 1/(1-n) rule: give up n% of the company only when the trade makes the remaining (1-n) worth more than the whole was before.

resources.title: How to Raise Money
resources.author: Paul Graham
resources.note: September 2013. Breadth-first fundraising weighted by expected value, get commitments in writing, and get back to work — fundraising is not the company.

resources.title: How to Get Startup Ideas
resources.author: Paul Graham
resources.note: November 2012. The best ideas are noticed, not made up: live in the future, build what is missing, prefer a deep well (a few users who need it urgently) to a shallow lake.

resources.title: Ramen Profitable
resources.author: Paul Graham
resources.note: July 2009. Covering the founders' living expenses from revenue changes the fundraising power balance and removes the ticking clock.

resources.title: How Not to Die
resources.author: Paul Graham
resources.note: August 2007. Startups rarely die in mid-keystroke — they die because the founders give up or run out of money while demoralized.

resources.title: Relentlessly Resourceful
resources.author: Paul Graham
resources.note: March 2009. The two-word test for good founders: relentlessly resourceful — the opposite of hapless.

resources.title: Be Good
resources.author: Paul Graham
resources.note: April 2008. Benevolence as strategy: being genuinely good to users compounds into growth, morale, and help from outside.

resources.title: YC Startup Library
resources.author: Y Combinator
resources.note: YC's open library of essays and videos across the whole lifecycle — the largest free curated corpus of partner-written startup advice.

resources.title: YC's Essential Startup Advice
resources.author: Y Combinator
resources.note: The distilled house advice: launch now, make something people want, talk to users, do things that don't scale, keep burn low.

resources.title: YC Documents (Post-Money SAFE forms and User Guide)
resources.author: Y Combinator
resources.note: Home of the post-money SAFE forms (cap, discount, MFN, international variants), the pro rata side letter, and the SAFE User Guide the cap-table engine's tests replay. Direct asset links are content-hashed and rotate; link this page.

resources.title: The YC SAFE — overview, generator and calculator
resources.author: Y Combinator
resources.note: YC's explainer for the post-money SAFE, with a document generator and a dilution calculator.

resources.title: YC Series A Term Sheet Template
resources.author: Y Combinator
resources.note: YC's annotated standard Series A term sheet — a clean baseline for what a fair priced-round term sheet looks like.

resources.title: First Round Review
resources.author: First Round Capital
resources.note: Long-form operator interviews and playbooks; the strongest open corpus on management and company building between seed and scale.

resources.title: The Struggle
resources.author: Ben Horowitz (Andreessen Horowitz)
resources.note: 2012. The definitive essay on the psychological low points of running a company — the Struggle is where greatness comes from, and everyone goes through it.

resources.title: Startup Playbook
resources.author: Sam Altman
resources.note: 2015. A single-sitting synthesis of the YC canon: a great idea, a great product, a great team, and great execution.

resources.title: Steve Blank — customer development corpus
resources.author: Steve Blank
resources.note: Origin of customer development and 'get out of the building' — the empirical method underneath the lean-startup movement.

resources.title: Stripe Atlas Guides
resources.author: Stripe
resources.note: Open guides on incorporation mechanics, equity, taxes, and early SaaS operations, written for first-time founders.

resources.title: The Holloway Guide to Equity Compensation
resources.author: Joshua Levy, Joe Wallin, et al. (Holloway)
resources.note: The most complete open reference on startup equity comp: options vs RSUs, 409A and strike prices, exercise windows, and tax pitfalls. Cited by lib/openstartup/equityComp.ts.

resources.title: Rewarding Talent — the Index Ventures option-plan handbook
resources.author: Index Ventures
resources.note: Published benchmarks and conventions for employee option pools and grant sizing, US and Europe. Cited by lib/openstartup/equityComp.ts.

resources.title: IRS Form 15620 — Section 83(b) Election
resources.author: Internal Revenue Service
resources.note: The official 83(b) election form and instructions, including the 30-day filing window. Also recorded in sources/registry.json (irs-form-15620-2025) for the rule cards.

resources.title: IRS — Apply for an Employer Identification Number (EIN) online
resources.author: Internal Revenue Service
resources.note: The official (free) EIN application — the step paid intermediaries most often resell to founders.

resources.title: Delaware Code, Title 8, Chapter 5 — Corporation Franchise Tax
resources.author: Delaware General Assembly (Delaware Code Online)
resources.note: The statute behind the March 1 annual report and franchise tax obligation (8 Del. C. §§ 502-504).

resources.title: Delaware Division of Corporations — Annual Report and Franchise Tax
resources.author: Delaware Division of Corporations
resources.note: Official filing instructions and due dates; the default authorized-shares bill is often recomputable far lower under the assumed-par-value-capital method.

resources.title: Delaware Division of Corporations — How to Form a New Business Entity
resources.author: Delaware Division of Corporations
resources.note: Official formation instructions and links to the state's own certificate forms and fee schedules.

resources.title: USPTO — Trademark basics
resources.author: United States Patent and Trademark Office
resources.note: The official primer on what trademarks protect, searching, and filing — before paying a clearance service.

resources.title: USPTO — Patent basics
resources.author: United States Patent and Trademark Office
resources.note: The official primer on patent types, timelines, and provisional applications.

resources.title: U.S. Copyright Office — Registration portal
resources.author: U.S. Copyright Office
resources.note: Official registration process and fees for software and content copyright.

resources.title: Cooley GO document generators and forms
resources.author: Cooley LLP
resources.note: Free generators for incorporation packages, Series Seed financings, offer letters, CIIAAs, NDAs, and advisor agreements. Per-document records live in open-documents/registry.json.

resources.title: NVCA Model Legal Documents
resources.author: National Venture Capital Association
resources.note: The industry-standard priced-round document suite (stock purchase agreement, charter, investors' rights, voting, ROFR, term sheet) that most US venture financings start from.

resources.title: Common Paper standard agreements
resources.author: Common Paper
resources.note: Openly licensed commercial contract standards (Cloud Service Agreement, Mutual NDA, DPA, and more) with committee-maintained terms.

resources.title: Bonterms standard forms download center
resources.author: Bonterms
resources.note: Committee-drafted open standard agreements (Cloud Terms, Mutual NDA, DPA, AI Addendum) downloadable from a single page.

resources.title: oneNDA — the open standard NDA
resources.author: oneNDA (Claustack)
resources.note: A single standardized mutual NDA adopted by thousands of companies; the point of the standard is to not negotiate it.

resources.title: The SAFT Project
resources.author: Cooley LLP and Protocol Labs
resources.note: The Simple Agreement for Future Tokens whitepaper and form. Securities-law treatment is contested; counsel is mandatory, not optional.
